scene: Ring tucked safely into your satchel, the breezy tower platform connects three departures.
picture: Flat side-view across the wooden departure terrace. On the left stands a docked red cable tram beside an open metal gate. The woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre. Centre shows a canal chute holding a wooden river barge. Right features a glass-roofed trolley waiting on level brass rails.
shown: a swinging red cable tram docked at an open gantry on the far left
a blue river barge resting in a water-lock chute at the centre
a sleek glass-roofed trolley waiting on polished rails on the far right
